name: Sheraton Puerto Rico Resort & Casino
insider_take: This beachfront gem sits in the heart of San Juan's hotel district, where Old World Spanish colonial charm meets modern Caribbean luxury just steps from El Condado's pristine shores.
whats_special: The Sheraton Puerto Rico is uniquely positioned as the only resort in San Juan offering both a full-service casino and direct beach access to Condado Beach. The hotel's iconic modernist architecture has been a Condado skyline landmark since 1968, and it's the closest luxury resort to Old San Juan's UNESCO World Heritage sites - you can actually see the historic El Morro fortress from select rooms.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 15+ facing north for stunning views of the historic San Juan Bay and El Morro fortress, especially magical at sunset when the fortress walls glow golden.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary hotel shuttle to explore Old San Juan's cobblestone streets and 500-year-old forts, then return for evening gaming at the on-site casino. The hotel's beachfront location means you're also perfectly positioned for water sports on Condado Lagoon, including paddleboarding through bioluminescent waters on certain nights.
pros: Prime beachfront location in Condado with direct beach access
Full-service casino and comprehensive resort amenities
Multiple dining venues and poolside bars
Central San Juan location near shopping and attractions
cons: Large resort property with potential for crowded common areas
Urban beachfront setting rather than secluded tropical location
